finding.summary: Required environment variables (ORCH_TICKET, E2E_DIR, E2E_HOOK) are used without validation. With `set -u` the script exits on first use, but the error message ('unbound variable') is unhelpful for debugging test failures.
finding.fix: Add explicit checks at the top: `[[ -n "$ORCH_TICKET" && -n "$E2E_DIR" && -n "$E2E_HOOK" ]] || { echo 'Missing required env vars' >&2; exit 1; }`. Also verify `$E2E_HOOK` is executable.
